accent-on-light.$description: Motion beats only: darker amber for marker and frame outlines on light surfaces (hell stage, white and glacier cards). Amber 800 is too dark for a filled marker; this value keeps 3:1 against white and against the ink lines. Not used for text or on dark surfaces.

action-on-light.$description: Motion beats only: darker cyan for action and recording graphics on light surfaces (hell stage, white and glacier cards). Cyan 600; cyan 500 is 2.4 to 2.8:1 on these surfaces.
